funds.note: A mutual fund, not an ETF — Vanguard’s target-date series has no ETF share class.

strategies.explainer: One fund that holds global stocks and bonds and gets more conservative as you age. What most 401k plans use as a default.
strategies.caution: These returns are Vanguard’s 2060 fund at 0.08% a year. In a 401k you get whichever 2060 fund the plan offers, and that one can cost several times more — enter its expense ratio to compare against what was on your menu.
